title: Backtest: post-earnings-announcement drift (PEAD) in Indian stocks (NSE Rs 500-50,000 cr, 2018-2025) - top-minus-bottom SUE quintile +4.2% over 63 trading days out of sample (t 4.0); long-only top quintile +2.4% vs size-matched controls gross, misses the 1%-cost rule by 0.06 pp
body: Own pre-registered backtest (run 2026-11-21; research_notes/Backtests/india_pead.md). Seeded random sample of 700 current NSE EQ/BE equities -> 580 usable companies, 10,026 quarterly-result events (train 2018-21: 4,336; test 2022-25: 5,690). SUE = seasonal random walk on standalone basic EPS (split-adjusted), (EPS_q - EPS_q-4) / sd of previous 4-8 seasonal changes; event = earliest NSE results announcement/broadcast timestamp; entry = close of first trading day strictly after it; quintiles within each fiscal quarter; inference across 16+16 quarters with 5,000-draw bootstrap. H1 (T-B, 63d): train +4.84% (CI +2.61 to +7.07, t 4.06), TEST +4.24% (CI +2.20 to +6.18, t 3.99) - passes t>3 in both periods and out of sample; 21d test +1.73% (t 3.9), 126d test +6.18% (t 3.5). H2 (top quintile vs median-116 size-matched controls, 63d): train +1.81% (t 2.1), test +2.36% (CI +0.94 to +3.67, t 3.23); net 0.5% round trip +1.86% (CI +0.44 to +3.17); net 1% +1.36% (CI -0.06 to +2.67) -> fails pre-committed rule 2 by a hair, so NOT labelled an edge candidate (126d clears 1% cost: +2.69%, CI +0.61 to +4.73, but 126d was not primary). Bottom quintile is the stronger leg: -2.70%/-2.13% vs controls at 63d (t -4.4/-4.8). Quintile ladder monotone (test Q1..Q5 -2.13, -0.80, +0.17, +1.02, +2.36%). Controls calibrated (all events vs controls ~0). H3 (bigger in smallest mcap tertile) NOT supported: small-minus-large test -0.44% (CI -4.8 to +3.8); exploratory: middle tertile (median Rs 2,800-3,600 cr) strongest in both periods (test 63d T-B +5.9%, t 4.6). Announcement-window T-B +3.75%/+4.95% (t 9/18) confirms dating. Revenue SUE weaker (test 63d T-B +2.1%, t 1.9). Skew: top-quintile event-level median excess -1.0% vs all-event median -2.6% (mechanical vs equal-weight controls); median and winsorised T-B still +3.2%/+4.1%; random 10-name baskets fall below 1% cost 21% of the time, 30-name 3%. Exploratory: long-only effect in test only in >= Rs 1,000 cr (+2.74%, t 3.9) vs < Rs 1,000 cr +0.36%; top-SUE with positive announcement reaction +3.32% (t 4.0). 2025 63d T-B only +0.9% (possible decay or noise). Survivorship: 253 of 1,508 (16.8%) Q3FY19 NSE filers are gone from today's list (failures + mergers); failures cluster in bottom SUE, so T-B likely understated. Lesson: PEAD survives in India (unlike US large/mid caps, Martineau 2022) - usable as an avoid-after-big-miss filter and a top-SUE research-queue tilt held 3-6 months in diversified baskets; not a multibagger engine.

survivorship.bias_direction: T-B likely understated; long-only roughly neutral

data.verdict: H1 supported (train and test, t~4); H2 supported gross, fails 1%-net CI rule by 0.06 pp -> not an edge candidate under rule 2 (borderline); H3 not supported

title: Tested rule: after NSE quarterly results, favour top-SUE-quintile stocks (Rs 500-50,000 cr) and avoid/exit bottom-quintile ones; hold 3-6 months in a diversified basket
body: Rule as pre-registered and tested 2026-11-21 (events 2018-2025). Signal: standalone basic EPS (split-adjusted) seasonal-random-walk SUE = (EPS_q - EPS_q-4) / sd of the previous 4-8 seasonal changes, ranked into quintiles among that fiscal quarter's results. Event = earliest NSE results announcement timestamp; enter at close of the first trading day strictly after it (sacrifices the day-0/1 reaction). Universe NSE Rs 500-50,000 cr at entry, >= 250 days listed. Benchmark = equal-weight mean of all same-sample stocks with mcap x0.5-x2 on the entry date. Result (insight:bt-india-pead-2018-2025): T-B 63d +4.2% test (t 4.0) and +4.8% train; long-only top quintile +2.36%/quarter vs controls gross (test), +1.36% net of 1% round trip with CI -0.06 to +2.67 -> NOT awarded 'edge candidate' under the pre-committed rule (borderline); 126d +3.7% gross. Bottom quintile -2.1% to -2.7% vs controls (t ~ -4.5) in both periods. Status: anomaly real; long-only use = (1) avoid/exit after big negative SUE (most robust leg, free); (2) tilt research queue toward top-SUE names, ideally >= Rs 1,000 cr with positive announcement reaction (exploratory), hold 3-6 months, >= ~30 names to collect the average (single names lag peers ~53% of the time). Not a stand-alone multibagger method. Next pre-registered tests: consolidated EPS from FY2020, full universe, confirmed-reaction filter, and 2026 quarters as fresh out-of-sample (2025 T-B only +0.9%).

data.signal: standalone EPS SUE quintile (seasonal random walk, 4-8 prior changes)
data.entry: close of first NSE trading day after results announcement
data.status: anomaly confirmed out of sample; long-only fails 1%-net CI rule by 0.06 pp (borderline); use as filter/tilt
data.next_test: consolidated EPS FY2020+, full universe, top-SUE + positive announcement reaction, 2026 out-of-sample
